تتبادرون (form VI)
# تَتَبَادَرُونَ (tatabādarūna) /ta.ta.baː.da.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of تَبَادَرَ (tabādara)
# تُتَبَادَرُونَ (tutabādarūna) /tu.ta.baː.da.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of تَبَادَرَ (tabādara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
